_comment: Weight manifest. Each entry maps a logical name to its relative path within the anonymous code-URL HuggingFace deposit, plus the SHA256 of the checkpoint as used to produce the paper's numbers. The repository handle is intentionally omitted here for double-blind anonymization; reviewers should resolve checkpoints via the code URL listed in the main paper PDF.
